name: Giorgis
title: The Grey
description: Grey-hoodie brawler with a silver hoop and planted hands. He fights smooth and direct — named for the house.
source_description: Male fighter, athletic, short dark hair, grey hoodie, silver hoop earring, silver chain, olive skin, aggressive rushdown.
special_desc: Slides through the lane and catches you on the exit.
ultimate_desc: A final flurry that hits like the name on the title screen.
